sources.title: Qwen3-TTS: Complete Guide to Open-Source Text-to-Speech Model
sources.snippet: What is Qwen3-TTS? Think of Qwen3-TTS as a text-to-speech model that actually works across languages. It's open-source (Apache 2.0), trained on 5+ million hours of speech data, and comes in two flavors: 1.7B version: The full-featured model. Better quality, needs more GPU power (6-8GB VRAM) 0.6B version: The lightweight option.
